# Mengantar Public API

> Documentation for the Mengantar Public API: create shipments, check shipping fees, manage addresses and pickup times, and read orders and batches. Each page below is plain Markdown. {BASE_URL} is the host you opened (production: https://api-public.mengantar.com, sandbox: https://sandbox.mengantar.com).

## Start here

- [Get started](/docs/en/get-started.md): API key, base URL, permissions, and the 403 Not allowed error.

## Address

- [Search address data](/docs/en/search-address-data.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/address/search
- [Add user's address](/docs/en/add-users-address.md): POST {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/address
- [Get user's addresses](/docs/en/get-users-addresses.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/address
- [Delete address](/docs/en/delete-address.md): DELETE {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/address
- [Update address](/docs/en/update-address.md): PUT {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/address/{id}

## Pickup time

- [Add Time](/docs/en/add-time.md): POST {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/time
- [Get Time](/docs/en/get-time.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/time

## Shipping fee

- [Check Shipping Fee](/docs/en/check-shipping-fee.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/order/estimate
- [Check Shipping Fee Public](/docs/en/check-shipping-fee-public.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/order/allEstimatePublic
- [Check Shipping Fee 3PL](/docs/en/check-shipping-fee-3pl.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/order/allEstimate3PL
- [Get Courier Performance](/docs/en/get-courier-performance.md): POST {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/order/getPerformancePublic

## Account

- [Get Invoices and Balance](/docs/en/get-invoices-and-balance.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/invoices
- [Get Receiver Score Number](/docs/en/get-receiver-score-number.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/getReceiverScoreByNumberUser
- [Webhook](/docs/en/webhook.md): HOOK

## Dropshipper

- [Add Dropshipper](/docs/en/add-dropshipper.md): POST {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/dropshippers
- [Search Dropshipper](/docs/en/search-dropshipper.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/dropshippers

## Batches & Orders

- [Create order](/docs/en/create-order.md): POST {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/order
- [Get My Users (assignee)](/docs/en/get-my-users-assignee.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/my-users
- [Pay unpaid](/docs/en/pay-unpaid.md): POST {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/order/pay-unpaid
- [Get orders](/docs/en/get-orders.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/order
- [Delete orders](/docs/en/delete-orders.md): DELETE {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/order
- [Get batches](/docs/en/get-batches.md): GET {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/batch
- [Delete batch](/docs/en/delete-batch.md): DELETE {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/batch
- [Simulate Order Status](/docs/en/simulate-order-status.md): POST {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/order/simulation (sandbox only)
- [Print Label PDF (BETA)](/docs/en/print-label-pdf-beta.md): POST {BASE_URL}/api/public/{API_KEY}/label-generation


# Bahasa Indonesia

> Halaman yang sama dalam Bahasa Indonesia. Nama endpoint, nama field, kode error, dan contoh kode tidak diterjemahkan.
